blocks.md: A position vector arriving over an inter-process communication bus cannot identify the entity, physical quantity, or units it describes. The same sequence of floating-point values could denote a workpiece center in meters, a joint angle in radians, or a contact force in newtons. A consumer requires these distinctions before executing a control law; a confusion between meters and millimeters alone scales the interpreted displacement by a factor of one thousand.

questions.q: The section **The Spatial Memory Handoff and State Invariants** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Every spatial claim carries evidence, estimate, and publication epochs, and only a physical measurement advances the evidence epoch, so prediction and republishing must preserve it.
Space last seen free stays free only until an unseen agent could have entered it, so occluded free space shrinks at that agent's speed bound and blind crossings need site controls, not memory.

When distinct state histories give identical measurements no estimator can separate them, and innovations stay near zero while the true state drifts, so observability must be designed in by excitation or added sensing.
A metric loop at camera rate keeps geometry current while foundation backbones update semantics on keyframes, and semantics never certify clearance.
